description: Source file implementing IARM request handlers for TR-069 host interface, including initialization, event handling, and RPC registration.

methods.name: hostIf_IARM_IF_Start
methods.description: Initializes and registers the host interface application to the IARM bus, including setting up message handlers.

methods.name: hostIf_getPwrContInterface
methods.description: Obtains the PowerController interface, initializes power management, and registers event callbacks (conditional on RDKV_TR69).

methods.name: TR69_HostIf_Mgr_Init
methods.description: Initializes the IARM bus for the TR-069 host interface manager.

methods.name: TR69_HostIf_Mgr_Get_RegisterCall
methods.description: Registers RPC calls and events for the host interface manager.

methods.name: hostIf_GetAttributesReqHandler
methods.description: Handles get attribute requests for host interface parameters.

methods.name: _GetAttributestr69HostIfMgr
methods.description: Wrapper for handling get attribute requests.

methods.name: hostIf_SetAttributesReqHandler
methods.description: Handles set attribute requests for host interface parameters.

methods.name: _SetAttributestr69HostIfMgr
methods.description: Wrapper for handling set attribute requests.

methods.name: hostIf_IARM_IF_Stop
methods.description: Stops the host interface, disconnects from IARM, and cleans up.

methods.name: tr69hostIfMgr_Stop
methods.description: Disconnects and terminates the IARM bus, unregisters callbacks, and terminates power controller if active.

methods.name: hostIf_SetReqHandler
methods.description: Handles set requests, setting requestor and calling message handler.

methods.name: hostIf_GetReqHandler
methods.description: Handles get requests, retrieves parameter info, and calls message handler.

methods.name: _hostIf_EventHandler
methods.description: Handles power management events and sends deep sleep notifications if RFC feature is enabled.
